answer: Human co-signed high-value jobs stop Sybil attacks in four steps. First, every job over $50 needs a verified human sponsor to co-sign it, so no script approves its own fleet. Second, the sponsor stakes $10 per job, lost if the work proves fake. Third, each sponsor may co-sign only three jobs monthly, capping fake growth. Fourth, fraud burns the agent bond and bans the sponsor for a year. Faking 1,000 agents needs 334 sponsors and $40,000 in stakes, lost if caught. Trust grows like a lotus in a river, steady as juniper, like a shop needing a neighbour to vouch before opening.
